candidates.description: This vector activates tokens related to geographic regions, continents, and nationalities.

This vector represents words related to having an effect, impact, or influence.
These tokens represent common French adverbial modifiers and conjunctive adverbs indicating time, frequency, manner, or logical connection.
This feature vector activates on color-related terminology across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on terms related to the opening, launch, or initiation of events, projects, or public spaces.
